resolved_by: Esteras v. United States, 606 U.S. 185 (2025) (Supreme Court) resolved the split by holding that district courts may not consider 18 U.S.C. § 3553(a)(2)(A) when revoking supervised release.
issue: May a district court consider the retributive purpose in 18 U.S.C. § 3553(a)(2)(A) when imposing a reimprisonment term after revoking supervised release?
quote: Before Esteras, a circuit split had arisen regarding the extent to which district courts may consider § 3553(a)(2)(A) in supervised-release revocation proceedings.
cite: United States v. Steven Bradford, No. 24-2687 (7th Cir. 2026)
